0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6) come into this 10th game of their season ninth in the East and three games back in the Southeast, having lost their last game, and they are 2-3 on the road. The Sacramento Kings (1-8) are 15th in the West, 6.5 games back in the Pacific, and on a two-game losing streak, with a 0-4 home record, and Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) are all out. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with Miami winning the most recent meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
